concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-apac-overview]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree-hosted direct-link APAC portal for recipients with at least one merchant account provisioned by a banking partner in the Asia-Pacific region, routing to account-tailored articles and preserving banking-partner variability and the multiple-account qualification; not a named-partner identification, funding claim, transfer of sibling processor terms, current bank policy, or payment-processing proof
warnings: Keep the exact at-least-one-account and banking-partner provisioning condition; do not imply that all merchant accounts share the APAC provisioning or that the provisioning bank funds an account.
Do not transfer attributes from AIB, Wells Fargo, Adyen, Chase, or other processor-specific overview pages, and do not treat this 2026-09-16 snapshot as current banking-partner policy.
